name: Check-in & Inventory
summary: How often Macs check in, whether startup and login run policies, and what inventory each Mac reports.

settings.title: Check-in every
settings.description: How often Macs contact Jamf Pro for policies and commands. 15 minutes balances responsiveness and load.

settings.title: Run policies at startup
settings.description: Installs the startup script so policies with the Startup trigger run.

settings.title: Run policies at login
settings.description: Installs the login hook so policies with the Login trigger run.

settings.title: Collect application usage
settings.description: Reports how long each app is in the foreground.

settings.title: Include home folder sizes
settings.description: Reports the size of each user's home folder. Slows inventory on Macs with large home folders.
